title: "Map prototype"

::: {.callout-warning}
## Placeholder geometry, not real data

This page tests the **Quarto + MapLibre + Observable JS** stack. The polygons are
arbitrary rectangles, not municipal boundaries. The filter is a technical demo.
The real municipal layer will replace this in Phase 1.
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
const group = view(Inputs.select(["All", "A", "B"], {label: "Group", value: "All"}));
window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("akiya-filter", {detail: {group}}));
html`<p class="map-note">Selected group: <strong>${group}</strong></p>`;
```

```{=html}
<link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/maplibre-gl@5/dist/maplibre-gl.css" rel="stylesheet">
<div id="map"></div>
<script type="module">
import maplibregl from "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/maplibre-gl@5/+esm";

const placeholder = {
  type: "FeatureCollection",
  features: [
    {
      type: "Feature",
      properties: { name: "Placeholder A", group: "A", value: 10 },
      geometry: {
        type: "Polygon",
        coordinates: [[
          [139.40, 35.50], [139.80, 35.50], [139.80, 35.80],
          [139.40, 35.80], [139.40, 35.50]
        ]]
      }
    },
    {
      type: "Feature",
      properties: { name: "Placeholder B", group: "B", value: 20 },
      geometry: {
        type: "Polygon",
        coordinates: [[
          [139.80, 35.50], [140.20, 35.50], [140.20, 35.80],
          [139.80, 35.80], [139.80, 35.50]
        ]]
      }
    },
    {
      type: "Feature",
      properties: { name: "Placeholder C", group: "A", value: 30 },
      geometry: {
        type: "Polygon",
        coordinates: [[
          [139.40, 35.20], [139.80, 35.20], [139.80, 35.50],
          [139.40, 35.50], [139.40, 35.20]
        ]]
      }
    }
  ]
};

const map = new maplibregl.Map({
  container: "map",
  style: {
    version: 8,
    sources: {
      gsi: {
        type: "raster",
        tiles: ["https://cyberjapandata.gsi.go.jp/xyz/pale/{z}/{x}/{y}.png"],
        tileSize: 256,
        attribution: "国土地理院"
      }
    },
    layers: [{ id: "gsi", type: "raster", source: "gsi" }]
  },
  center: [139.70, 35.65],
  zoom: 7
});

map.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl(), "top-right");

map.on("load", () => {
  map.addSource("municipalities", { type: "geojson", data: placeholder });

  map.addLayer({
    id: "municipalities-fill",
    type: "fill",
    source: "municipalities",
    paint: {
      "fill-color": [
        "match", ["get", "group"],
        "A", "#4c78a8",
        "B", "#f58518",
        "#54a24b"
      ],
      "fill-opacity": 0.55
    }
  });

  map.addLayer({
    id: "municipalities-line",
    type: "line",
    source: "municipalities",
    paint: { "line-color": "#ffffff", "line-width": 1.5 }
  });

  map.on("click", "municipalities-fill", (event) => {
    const props = event.features[0].properties;
    new maplibregl.Popup()
      .setLngLat(event.lngLat)
      .setHTML(
        `<strong>${props.name}</strong><br>` +
        `Group: ${props.group}<br>` +
        `Value: ${props.value}`
      )
      .addTo(map);
  });

  map.on("mouseenter", "municipalities-fill", () => {
    map.getCanvas().style.cursor = "pointer";
  });
  map.on("mouseleave", "municipalities-fill", () => {
    map.getCanvas().style.cursor = "";
  });

  window.akiyaMapReady = true;
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event("akiya-ready"));
});

window.updateAkiyaMap = (group) => {
  if (!map.getLayer("municipalities-fill")) return;
  const filter = group === "All" ? null : ["==", ["get", "group"], group];
  map.setFilter("municipalities-fill", filter);
  map.setFilter("municipalities-line", filter);
};

window.addEventListener("akiya-filter", (event) => {
  window.updateAkiyaMap(event.detail.group);
});
</script>
```

## What this tests

- **Quarto** renders the page as a static HTML site.
- **Observable JS** provides the filter and will later host the charts.
- **MapLibre** renders a raster basemap and a GeoJSON layer.
- **The bridge** is a custom event: OJS dispatches `akiya-filter`; the map listens
  and updates its layer filter.

In the real product, the GeoJSON will be a municipal layer with the risk,
activation, and capacity indicators. The OJS filter will control the map, the
charts, and the table together.
